messages:
olivia-support: customer reported strange Console analytics: tokens/sec for route /v1/generate shows negative dips around 09:13 UTC and the streaming TTFT line is missing for that route. they attached a screenshot and said invoices look suspicious.
alerts-bot: [anomaly] negative tokens/sec on streaming-prod-us-west-2 (shard-3) at 2026-03-16T09:13:18Z — alert=A-101334
olivia-support: pasted customer snippet: "metric tokens_total for /v1/generate jumped 1,845,640 -> 0 -> 1,845,648 across adjacent windows" — sounds like a counter wrap/reset.
mike-oncall: which service is responsible for tokens_total rollups? any config flips or deploys overnight?
olivia-support: metrics-rollup in streaming-prod-us-west-2. deploy-bot shows a deploy earlier this morning (metrics-rollup:v3.5.0 at 02:08 UTC).
deploy-bot: deploy metrics-rollup:v3.5.0 completed at 2026-03-16T02:08:21Z by ci/cd
jordan-sre: negative per-window rate implies the rollup computed a raw diff without monotonic protection or we ingested out-of-order offsets. can we check kafka partition offsets and counters for the 09:12-09:16 window?
leah-analytics: quick query against raw counters: partition 4 for tokens_total shows offset jump 423,110 -> 0 at ~2026-03-16T09:13:53Z. producer process restarted and reset the counter. our rollup pipeline appears to have been running with MONOTONIC_GUARD disabled in some pods during the recent rollout. that would let a reset produce a negative delta.
sam-platform: I can confirm a temporary experiment toggled MONOTONIC_GUARD=false to speed certain backfills and three replicas rolled with that setting during the v3.5.0 rollout window.
mike-oncall: immediate mitigation: mask negative tokens/sec points to 0 in Console presentation so customers and billing see non-negative rates. UI team — can you push a small display clamp behind a feature flag?
ui-eng: yes, we can implement a client-side clamp for streaming charts and flip a flag for affected users. estimate ~15-25 minutes to ship and enable for the streaming dashboard.
leah-analytics: backend fix: re-enable monotonic guard, perform a controlled rolling restart of metrics-rollup so consumers rebalance, then run a deterministic backfill for the affected interval to recompute tokens/sec from raw tokens_total.
sam-platform: plan: kubectl -n infra set env deployment/metrics-rollup MONOTONIC_GUARD=true --record on canary pods, wait 5-10m, then roll the rest. after that we'll run a partition-aware backfill.
jordan-sre: after enabling, do a graceful rolling restart (SIGTERM -> drain -> restart) and ensure consumer lag stays low. add an alert to fire if any negative tokens/sec points are observed during deploy.
leah-analytics: backfill command to run (safe mode):
```
./bin/rollup_backfill --src counters_raw --metric tokens_total --derive tokens_per_sec --start 2026-03-16T09:00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T09:20:00Z --partitions all --out s3://redwood-support/backfills/101334-20260316
```
sam-platform: snapshotting raw partition counters for billing reconciliation at s3://redwood-support/exports/counters/2026-03-16/09-13-snapshot-101334.json and notifying billing-ops.
billing-ops: received snapshot link, will pause billing action until after backfill and reconciliation. please include a diff report.
mike-oncall: ETA: UI clamp ~20m, MONOTONIC_GUARD flip + rolling restart ~30-45m, backfill scheduled tonight during low-traffic window (estimate runtime 1-3h depending on throughput). olivia-support — relay to customer and ask them to hold off billing dispute while we reconcile.
olivia-support: messaging customer: "We identified a short producer restart that reset the tokens counter; during a recent rollout a monotonic guard was temporarily disabled which allowed negative deltas to appear. We'll mask negative values in the Console immediately and run a backfill to recompute historical tokens/sec and reconcile billing. ETA: clamp ~20m, full recompute tonight. We'll open a billing ticket and share the counter export." :thumbsup: 
mike-oncall: creating incident with severity P2. owners: jordan-sre (rollout/backfill monitor), sam-platform (config + canary), leah-analytics (backfill + reconciliation), olivia-support (customer comms).
sam-platform: enabling MONOTONIC_GUARD on two canary pods now and watching consumer lag and restart behavior. will roll to remaining replicas after 10m stability window.
deploy-bot: scheduled backfill job queued: job-101334-rollup-backfill scheduled 2026-03-16T23:00:00Z
leah-analytics: post-backfill checklist: verify recomputed tokens/sec for 09:00-09:20 matches expected non-reset patterns, export a reconciliation CSV for billing, store raw counters and backfill output for audit, and add a regression alert that triggers on any negative tokens/sec value.
ui-eng: clamp feature flag deployed to canary and enabled for streaming dashboards at 2026-03-16T09:36:12Z. backend still returns original numbers but UI now masks negatives.
mike-oncall: good. once backfill completes and billing ops signs off we'll remove the clamp and validate final numbers. also add unit/integration tests to assert monotonic_guard never disabled across full replica set during deploy.
olivia-support: customer acknowledged and will await reconciliation before escalating billing. I'll attach billing ticket number and close the loop after backfill and reconciliation.
jordan-sre: will post backfill logs and verification output in this thread after the 23:00 run. keeping incident open until reconciliation confirmed.
